features.name: area_per_room
features.description: Average area per room, indicating spaciousness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous measure of room size, which is often linearly correlated with property value.

features.name: log_area_sqm
features.description: Log-transformed area to reduce skewness and linearize relationships.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps linear models handle right-skewed area distributions more effectively.

features.name: floor_normalized
features.description: Floor number normalized to a 0-1 scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Keeps feature scales consistent for SVM margin calculations.

features.name: is_ground_or_basement
features.description: Indicator for ground floor or basement properties.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the non-linear value drop often associated with lowest floors in a linear-friendly way.

features.name: title_normalized
features.expected_model_benefit: Scales the title feature for stable SVM optimization.

features.name: location_normalized
features.expected_model_benefit: Scales the location feature for stable SVM optimization.

features.name: area_location_interaction
features.description: Interaction between normalized area and normalized location.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear model to capture the combined effect of size and location.

features.name: rooms_to_floor_ratio
features.description: Ratio of rooms to floor level.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures architectural patterns (e.g., large apartments on lower vs higher floors).

features.name: scraped_at_normalized
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a scaled temporal feature for the linear model.

features.name: spaciousness_index
features.description: An index measuring how spacious the property is beyond a baseline of 15 sqm per room.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous severity measure of spaciousness, useful for linear margins.

features.name: luxury_semantic_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of luxury level based on the combination of area, rooms, and floor.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-linear luxury concepts in a single continuous score suitable for linear models.

features.name: location_desirability_estimate
features.description: Semantic estimation of location desirability based on the location ID and property characteristics.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates categorical or opaque location IDs into a continuous desirability score.
